product.title: Millionaires' Row Cruise

description.text: Experience a fully narrated sightseeing cruise through Miami's Biscayne Bay and Millionaires' Row. You will pass celebrity homes, island neighborhoods, and skyline landmarks with live commentary from the onboard guide. This two-level vessel offers shaded seating, open-air views, and a relaxed pace for photo stops and waterfront storytelling.

highlights: Narrated Biscayne Bay cruise with Millionaires' Row mansion views
Open-air upper deck and climate-friendly shaded lower seating
See Fisher Island, Star Island, and Miami skyline landmarks
Great for first-time visitors and families seeking a relaxed tour
additionalInfo: Please arrive 30 minutes before departure for boarding.
Children must be accompanied by an adult.
Tour operates in most weather conditions.

start.description: Bayside Marketplace, 401 Biscayne Blvd, Miami, FL 33132. Check in at the dockside ticket booth.

product.itinerarySummary: Cruise through Biscayne Bay and past Millionaires' Row, with narration highlighting celebrity estates and city history.

itineraryItems.title: Biscayne Bay Skyline Cruise
itineraryItems.description: Enjoy panoramic views of Downtown Miami and Brickell waterfront towers.

itineraryItems.title: Millionaires' Row

faqs.question: Is this tour suitable for children?
faqs.answer: Yes. The cruise is family-friendly and welcomes children with adult supervision.

faqs.question: Are food and drinks available onboard?
faqs.answer: Light snacks and drinks are typically available for purchase depending on departure.

faqs.question: Where is the meeting point?
faqs.answer: Meet at Bayside Marketplace, 401 Biscayne Blvd, Miami, FL 33132.
